description: Second step after builder_start_from_idea (or builder_start_from_document): the answers to its questions and an optional note make the brief, the builder app is made and its design step starts. answers: one per question the person answered, { id: "q1", choice: chip number from 0 } or { id, choice: "decide" } (You decide) or { id, text: their own words }; questions left out count as You decide. skip: true = Skip questions (the answers are not used, sensible defaults instead). note = anything else the person wants or thinks is missing (optional, up to 1000 characters). The design costs designCredits (designSpec in builder_status prices, given back if it fails): tell the person the cost, ask, and pass confirm: true. Answers app (id, name), designStarted, note (why the design did not start, for example not enough credits: the app is saved and its Design button starts it later) and url (the app page in the dashboard). Follow the design with builder_status (app). Calling again for the same intake returns the same app. Developer role. Every plan with an account.

choice.description: Chip number from 0, or "decide" for You decide

text.description: The answer in the person's own words (up to 300 characters are used)

appId.description: Optional app id for the stores (Android package and iOS bundle id), like com.yourcompany.app; replaces the one given to builder_start_from_idea. Empty string = the generated one.

skip.description: Skip questions: design with sensible defaults

name: builder_answer_questions
title: Answer the start questions and design the app
